_comment: English edition (Singapore) learning resources. Hand-checked: each URL was opened on 2026-11-14. This is a list of standing official resources, not a calendar of events.

meta.title: Learning resources for hospital AI governance in Singapore
meta.description: Official guidance, a toolkit and breach-reporting pages from MOH, HSA and the PDPC that hospital administrators and compliance teams use to learn about AI governance and data protection.
meta.lead: There is no single official events calendar for hospital AI. Here are standing resources from official sources, each opened and checked.

notice: Standing resources, not scheduled events. Check each page for what it currently offers.

items.name: AIHGle 2.0 deployers’ toolkit
items.body: A toolkit for deployers, listed on MOH’s AIHGle 2.0 page alongside the guidelines and an infographic on roles and responsibilities.
items.audience: Hospital administrators, quality and compliance staff.

items.name: AIHGle 2.0 roles and responsibilities infographic
items.body: A one-page picture of who does what between developers, deployers and users.
items.audience: Anyone briefing a committee on AI governance.

items.name: HSA medical device guidance documents
items.body: The list of HSA guidance on software medical devices, risk classification, change management, telehealth products and cybersecurity.
items.audience: Procurement, clinical engineering and compliance staff.

items.name: How to report a data breach
items.body: The PDPC’s page on notifying a data breach, with a self-assessment tool to decide whether a breach is notifiable.
items.audience: Data protection officers and IT security staff.
items.sourceLabel: How to report a data breach

items.name: Guide on Managing and Notifying Data Breaches
items.body: The guide whose timelines this site cites: assess within 30 calendar days, notify within 3 calendar days once notifiable.
items.audience: Data protection officers, IT and legal staff.
items.sourceLabel: Guide on Managing and Notifying Data Breaches
